# ReadmeGenAI

> ReadmeGenAI is a free, open-source AI README generator for GitHub projects. Paste a GitHub repository URL and it analyzes the repo structure and metadata with Google Gemini, then returns a professional README.md in clean, standard Markdown.

- Works with any public GitHub repository. Sign in with GitHub to generate READMEs for private repositories.
- READMEs can be generated in English, Danish, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic and Turkish.
- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Octokit and the Gemini API. Licensed under MIT.

## Pages

- [Home](https://readmegen-ai.vercel.app/): Overview of ReadmeGenAI and what it does
- [Generate](https://readmegen-ai.vercel.app/generate): Paste a GitHub repository URL and generate a README
- [Features](https://readmegen-ai.vercel.app/features): Gemini-powered generation, GitHub integration and framework-aware output
- [Examples](https://readmegen-ai.vercel.app/examples): Sample READMEs generated for Next.js apps, TypeScript libraries, Go backends and more
- [Docs](https://readmegen-ai.vercel.app/docs): Quick start, configuration, troubleshooting and FAQ
